title: A little psychedelic driving game (WIP) with Three JS
author: dummum

comments.author: AMadHammer
comments.body: How did you end up with those colors? Cool stuff.

replies.author: dummum
replies.body: thanks! Im animating the color of the sun and the fog slowly, so it kinda keeps mixing with the underlying color.

replies.author: AMadHammer
replies.body: It looks cool. Is the light a different color or is it the fog? I just like how it reflects off the car.

replies.author: dummum
replies.body: The fog color is the sun color. The car has some of that reflection painted in the texture

comments.author: Recoil42
comments.body: What are you using for asset creation? Or are the assets downloaded?

replies.author: dummum
replies.body: I made them using gravity sketch and blender
